request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:SUBMARINE

layers.text: Turn it into a small stubby candy submarine lying level, no longer than the boat's hull is now: remove the mast, the wafer sail and the pennant; the hull becomes one closed short fat capsule, rounded at both ends, of the same dark chocolate #5a3423 with pale pink frosting #ffb8d8 dripping along its top and three round pale mint portholes in a row; on top one small pink gumdrop tower with a candy-cane periscope. Nothing red. Keep the thick black outline and style, with nothing under the hull.
